Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case, since the petitioners and complainant have arrived at compromise and settled their dispute and in the view of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex court in the case of B.S. Joshi Vs. State of Haryana, reported in 2003 (4) SCC p.675 in which it has been held that the proceedings under Section 498A IPC can be quashed because it is the matrimonial matter, the criminal proceedings in Criminal Case No.10/2017 (646/2017) pending before the learned Addl. Chief Judicial magistrate, Sardarshahar is liable to be set aside.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Accordingly, the criminal proceedings in Criminal Case No.10/2017 (646/2017) pending before the Addl. Chief Judicial magistrate, Sardarshahar, arising out of Complaint Case No.10/2017 is hereby set aside on the basis of the compromise arrived at between the parties.
The misc. petition is disposed of.
Stay petition is also decided accordingly.
